# Maadhav V H

> AI/ML engineer from Coimbatore building small LLMs, vision and RAG systems that run on-device, on phone NPUs and Arm boards. SEMICON India 2026 runner-up. ECE undergraduate (2028), open to internships.

I build ML systems — small LLMs, vision models, RAG — and get them running on real hardware: phone NPUs, Arm boards, a car's own signals.

Role: ai / ml engineer · on-device ai. Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Site: https://vhmaadhav.com/

## Projects
- [DriftSense](https://github.com/vhmaadhav/semicon-driftsense): Finds where a wafer-inspection microscope actually is — under unknown 8–12× zoom and ±5° rotation — or says the pattern isn’t there. Proof: match F1 0.91 on 2,250 pairs · CAD-to-SEM within 1 px on 600.
- VehicleGPT: Ask a car about its own data: a small LLM answering from CAN logs, fully offline. Proof: hybrid 29.5% → 95.5% on 200 q · best single model 82% @ 1.74 s, 2 cores / 2 GiB.
- Mouna: Speak by mouthing words — silent lip-reading turned into voice on a phone NPU, no internet. Proof: false utterances 23% → 7% · Kannada top-1 75.3%.
- Rakshak-Edge: Catches scam SMS and links on an Arm device, offline — and refuses explanations it can’t back up. Proof: offline on Arm · phase 1 due nov 2026.
- DT Guardian: Simulated edge controller for a 200 kVA transformer: MILP scheduling of battery, EV charging and pump loads. Proof: energy not served, 6 h outage: 121.2 → 56.7 kWh (−53%).
- Axiom Trace: A tutor that knows what you know: knowledge-graph RAG with mastery tracking and animated ECE explanations. Proof: Next.js web + Kotlin app · 176 tests.
- Also on GitHub: [embeddinggemma-mobile-benchmark](https://github.com/vhmaadhav/embeddinggemma-mobile-benchmark), [hiver-email-suggested-response](https://github.com/vhmaadhav/hiver-email-suggested-response)

## Experience
- Machine Learning Intern, PhobosQ (2025-08 to 2025-10, 3 months): Built scikit-learn pipelines on clinical sensor data and compressed the models to run inference on resource-constrained hardware.
- Software Engineering Intern, Embedded Systems, Enthu Technology Solutions (2025-12 to 2026-01, 2 months): Sensor data acquisition over UART/SPI/I²C with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and LoRaWAN uplinks.
